name: Student transformation story
hint: Lead with a concrete story: a student who discovered a creative career path at a workshop and what they built.

name: Free on-campus workshop
hint: Offer to run ONE free creative-careers workshop for their Class 11-12 students this term, on their campus.

name: Parent-demand insight
hint: A data point on rising parent/student interest in design, media and entrepreneurship careers beyond engineering/medicine.

name: Event or showcase invite
hint: Invite the principal/coordinator to a LIT student showcase or principals' roundtable on future-of-careers.

name: Partner-school case study
hint: A comparable school's experience: what the workshop looked like, student feedback, what the school gained.

name: Time-sensitive term slot
hint: Limited workshop slots this term; align to their event calendar before exam season closes the window.

name: Peer social proof
hint: Which reputed schools in their city already run creative-careers programming; positioning risk of lagging peers.
